user.job: choose the LLM orchestration and semi-automatic distillation stack that turns captured dual-track items into distilled meta-cognition claims with a human review loop, running locally and privately

baseline.workflow: no LLM stack chosen; prior research fixed the storage substrate as Postgres+pgvector and concluded that no knowledge app covers ZKC's dual-track model, decay, or attention scheduling
failureModes: distillation has no human review, so low-quality claims enter the store
models require cloud APIs, breaking the privacy/offline constraint
no orchestration, so multi-step distillation cannot resume after interruption
no quality signal to judge whether distillation worked

targetOutcome: select the MVP LLM stack and state explicitly which distillation semantics ZKC must own
goals: compare candidates on T3.1 human-in-the-loop distillation and T3.3 orchestration/localization
determine whether a fully local/offline distillation pipeline is feasible
recommend a composition with deferred extras
nonGoals: do not build the distillation pipeline in this step
do not adopt a heavy evaluation platform for MVP

constraints.statement: personal data; local/offline inference strongly preferred
prefer minimal infrastructure for a solo MVP
must fit the already-chosen Postgres + pgvector substrate
findings pinned to a sealed ledger snapshot on 2026-10-29

assumptions: stars and topicMatch are discovery signals, not capability scores
a local open-weight model is acceptable for routine extraction
human review needs to interrupt a running workflow, not only annotate afterwards
decisionScope: LLM orchestration and distillation stack selection for the ZKC architecture

options.name: Ollama + Instructor + LangGraph as the MVP composition
LiteLLM gateway plus a separate annotation and eval platform
minimal in-app orchestration with no external framework
